0.original: Yugiri has a simple plan for finding Lord Hien.

26.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, enter any phrase containing “Mol” to search for a Mol woman.

48.original: Is it just me, or is everyone here Xaela?

49.original: I must confess that this is my first time on the Steppe...

50.original: When last I spoke with Lord Hien, he said he spent much time in these markets. I had hoped we might find him here today, but alas...

51.original: Hey, Yugiri, I've been meaning to ask─there are an awful lot of Xaela here, aren't there?

52.original: Oh, I assumed you knew. The Azim Steppe has been home to the nomadic tribes of the Xaela since antiquity.

53.original: More than fifty roam these lands, and though they do not constitute a nation, there is a hierarchy of sorts, determined through ritual combat.

54.original: Funny... If they're so busy fighting each other, you'd think the Empire would be able to march in and take the Steppe with ease. I wonder why they haven't...

56.original: Perhaps they see little value in it, especially given the fierce reputation of the Xaela warriors who would fight tooth and nail to oppose them.

57.original: These lands were not made for men. The soil is thin, and the weather unforgiving.

58.original: The Xaela found ways to survive, it is true. But they are made of sterner stuff than most imperials─conscript or citizen.

59.original: Thanks for taking the time to explain. It sounds like I've got a lot to learn. Later, I mean. We're meant to be looking for Hien!

60.original: People from many tribes gather in Reunion to trade goods and information. I should be surprised if we cannot learn something of value here.

61.original: Let us make our inquiries separately. <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, why don't you speak with some of the merchants here?

62.original: Buuz! Fresh buuz! Your choice of lamb or dzo! Guaranteed to satisfy! How many will you have, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>?

63.original: Eh? A Doman? Unless another Dazkar is keeping him in her yurt, he is not here. <snort> More fool her if she took a Doman for a husband.

64.original: But enough about Domans─let us speak of buuz instead! You cannot come to the Azim Steppe and not sample this most traditional of delicacies!

65.original: But enough about Domans─let us speak of buuz instead! Surely your mother or father made you some when you were little? A Xaela who never eats buuz is never a whole Xaela!

66.original: You there! Why don't you have a buuz in your hand right now?

67.original: What fortune you have to come hither at this time! Freshly slaughtered, every cut available on request. Organs too─hearts, livers, brains. Or a brace of blood sausages, if you desire only a snack!

68.original: A Doman? Poor meat they make, Domans─ I jest, I jest. Hmm...I did see a young Mol in the company of one some few days ago...

69.original: Are you sure you do not wish to purchase anything? Organs as fresh as these will be gone before you know it!

70.original: Roasted fish with pumpkin! An exotic foreign delicacy, cooked to perfection, beloved without the Steppe! Come, come!

71.original: You seek Domans? Then you are come to the wrong place, my friend. Delicious as my foodstuffs are, they find little favor with those from the south.

72.original: Now, if it were Goro you were looking for, on the other hand, then I might be able to help you. They <hex:021A020203>flock<hex:021A020103> to my stall!

73.original: Doubtless you know well the wonders of Western cuisine. Then I need not persuade you to partake, yes? Come, come─eat your fill!

74.original: I did not think it would be so expensive...

75.original: There, there. You did well to travel so far.

77.original: I have brought you a new brush, my beloved. So smooth and silky your mane shall be─the envy of every other man...

78.original: Hm? Say again? You are seeking who?

79.original: Ah, the Doman. I know of whom you speak. He comes and goes with a Mol girl.

80.original: Though I could not describe her. I only know that she is Mol because I heard them talking as they passed.

81.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase that contains “Mol” to ask the Xaela in Reunion if they are of the Mol tribe.

82.original: Oh, my dearest, how do I love thee? Let me count the ways...

83.original: I am Ura, if you must know. Come down from the mountains in the north. If there is nothing else...

84.original: You take me for a Mol!? I am Oronir! Compare me not with ones so weak and lowly!

85.original: ...Yes? I am Mol. My name is Cirina. May I help you?

86.original: Oh... Oh, I see. You are looking for Hien. In that case─

87.original: How urgent this business must be to leave our conversation unfinished!

88.original: The kinsai. Will you buy it? There is but one bundle left. If not, then─

89.original: I will, I will! Though I had not thought to pay so high a price...

90.original: It is a bargain for which you should be grateful. If you lack the coin, then the fault is your own, and you will leave with nothing.

91.original: Please, I must have the kinsai! The gods themselves requested it! We are bound to their will!

92.original: ...Pay me the difference in whisperroot. I will sell it to the next apothecary to pass through Reunion, and we will each feel fairly treated.

93.original: But do not tarry. Should another come before you, coin in hand, I will not refuse him.

94.original: I understand. Thank you for this kindness!

95.original: I am sorry, but we must speak of Hien later. I cannot leave Reunion without that kinsai...
